SYMPTOM: Vinted visual search returning wrong items (black polo, wrong colors) when per-item crops are uploaded
CAUSE: Gemini bounding box crops from street outfit photos produce tiny/contextual images — watch is 43x32px, belt is 205x46px, sunglasses similar. Vinted's CLIP model expects clean product images, not cropped fragments of a person wearing the item.
GOOD CROPS (>150x150): polo 338x379, pants 251x566, bag 197x304, sneakers 107x310 (narrow but OK)
BAD CROPS: belt 205x46 (thin strip), watch 43x32 (blob), sunglasses (small)
FIX OPTIONS:
1. Min-size threshold: only use image search for crops >150x150px, text-only fallback for accessories
2. Pad small crops with neutral border to minimum size before uploading (may or may not help)
3. Full-photo upload: one UUID for whole outfit, use text filters per item
4. Ship as-is and accept accessories won't get great visual matches
PREVENT: Apply min-size threshold check before sending crop to Playwright microservice
